Which data, why, and where it goes.
Novila gives general advice, not medical advice. Ask a doctor or physiotherapist if you are unsure.
Everything you log is saved on this phone only. Novila has no account and no cloud, so nothing can be restored once deleted.

Your profile and goals, your measurements, your logged sleep, food, drinks and workouts, your food preferences and both coaches\' answers are deleted from this phone. Your reminders are turned off. This cannot be undone. Data in Health Connect is not affected.
No ads, no analytics and no network calls. Your health data stays on the phone.
The libraries Novila is built on, with their licenses.
Novila is built so that your health data stays with you. This policy says what the app handles, where it is kept, who can see it and what you can do about it.

What you enter yourself: your name, birth year, height, weight and body measurements; your sleep, food, drinks and workouts, with effort and pain after a session; your answers to the training and sleep coaches; your food preferences, including allergies; and your goals, reminders and settings. If you allow it, also what Novila reads from Health Connect, below. Everything is optional, and Novila works without a name or an account.

Only on this phone, encrypted with a key from the phone\'s Android Keystore. Novila has no account and no server, and the app has no access to the internet, so nothing you log can be sent anywhere. Novila\'s data is left out of Android\'s backup and of transfers to a new phone.

If you allow it, Novila reads today\'s steps and active calories, your workouts from the last five weeks, your sleep up to two years back, and your resting heart rate and heart rate variability from the last two weeks. The data is read only while the app is open, used only to show your day and plan your training, and kept only in memory: Novila never saves it, never writes to Health Connect and never shares it. Novila\'s use of data from Health Connect follows the Health Connect permissions policy, including its Limited Use requirements. You can turn off access at any time in Health Connect.
If your phone has Gemini Nano, the coach can write a comment on your week when you ask for one. The model runs on the phone, in Android\'s AICore, and the plan it reads never leaves the phone.
Novila has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your data is not sold, not shared with anyone and not used for advertising. The developer never receives it.

Reminders you turn on show a short notification, and the widget, if you add it, shows today\'s balance, sleep, food and water on your home screen. Anyone who sees your phone can see them. You can turn reminders off and remove the widget at any time.

You can see and change what you have logged in the app. Delete all data under Settings removes your health data from the phone at once, and uninstalling Novila removes all of it. No copy exists anywhere else, so there is nothing more for the developer to delete or hand over. Data in Health Connect is managed in Health Connect.

Novila is installed through Google Play, and Health Connect, AICore and Gemini Nano are parts of Android made by Google. They follow Google\'s privacy policy. If you share usage and diagnostics with Google, Google Play may give the developer crash reports, which do not contain what you log in Novila.
Novila is made for adults and is not directed at children.

Questions about privacy go to the developer\'s contact address on Novila\'s page in Google Play. You can also complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY). If this policy changes, the new version comes with an app update, with its date below.
Hanken Grotesk typeface, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Icons from Material Symbols, Apache License 2.0.
Novila gives general advice on exercise, sleep and food. It is not a medical device, and it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease.
Talk to a doctor or physiotherapist before you start training if you have an illness, an injury or pain, are pregnant, or are unsure whether training suits you.
Stop and rest if you feel chest pain, dizziness, shortness of breath or sharp pain. Seek care if it does not pass. In an emergency, call 112.
The coach\'s gentle training programs are general and do not replace a plan from your physiotherapist. Follow the pain limit, and your caregiver\'s advice before Novila\'s.
The coach\'s comment is written by Gemini Nano on your phone. AI can be wrong. The program itself is made without AI, and it is what counts.
Activity goals follow the WHO\'s physical activity guidelines, and the nutrition score follows the Swedish Food Agency\'s dietary guidelines. Your own needs can differ.

Novila only reminds you about what you haven\'t logged yet, and only on the days it matters. Reminders come as notifications; the first time, your phone asks whether Novila may show them.
